modules.title: Introduction to National Development
modules.html:
Sustainable development and the citizen's role in national growth. This section covers introduction to national development.

Key points

  • Which of the following is a way of promoting national unity — Inter-ethnic marriages.
  • The first Nigerian national flag was designed by _____. — Taiwo Akinkunmi.
  • National Unity threat: — Tribalism.
  • National Integrity means: — Honesty and Unity.
  • Who designed the Nigerian national flag — Taiwo Akinkunmi.

Worked examples

Q: Which of the following is a way of promoting national unity?
A: Inter-ethnic marriages — When people from different ethnic groups marry, it builds social ties that cut across tribal lines, fostering unity.

Q: The first Nigerian national flag was designed by _____.
A: Taiwo Akinkunmi — Michael Taiwo Akinkunmi designed the Green-White-Green flag in 1959 while he was a student in London.

examples.q: Which of the following is a way of promoting national unity?
The first Nigerian national flag was designed by _____.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a way of promoting national unity?
quiz.solution: When people from different ethnic groups marry, it builds social ties that cut across tribal lines, fostering unity.

quiz.q: The first Nigerian national flag was designed by _____.
quiz.solution: Michael Taiwo Akinkunmi designed the Green-White-Green flag in 1959 while he was a student in London.

quiz.q: National Unity threat:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Tribalism.

quiz.q: National Integrity means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Honesty and Unity.

quiz.q: Who designed the Nigerian national flag?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Taiwo Akinkunmi.

quiz.q: National integrity implies:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Honesty and unity.

quiz.q: National Unity is promoted by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: NYSC.

quiz.q: A threat to national unity is:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Tribalism/Ethnicity.

quiz.q: Skills acquired by an individual to become productive and self-reliant are called _____ skills.
quiz.solution: Empowerment skills are practical abilities that allow individuals to create wealth and be self-sufficient.

quiz.q: The acronym NYSC stands for _____.
quiz.solution: The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) was established in 1973 to involve Nigerian graduates in nation-building and the development of the country.

quiz.q: Nationalism is defined as _____.
options: Deep love and devotion to one's own country
quiz.solution: Nationalism is a sense of belonging and loyalty to one's nation and the desire to see it independent and prosperous.

quiz.q: Which of the following can prevent communal labor?
quiz.solution: Communal labor depends on the willingness of community members to participate; apathy or laziness hinders its success.

quiz.q: A major consequence of cultism on the academic environment is _____.
quiz.solution: Cult activities often lead to violence, strikes, and closures of schools, which severely disrupt the academic calendar.

quiz.q: The motto of Nigeria as inscribed on the Coat of Arms is _____.
options: Unity and Faith, Peace and Progress
quiz.solution: The current national motto of Nigeria is 'Unity and Faith, Peace and Progress'.

quiz.q: Cultism on campus leads to _____.
quiz.solution: Participation in cultism is a serious offense that results in the immediate expulsion (rustication) of students from tertiary institutions.

quiz.q: Cultism is most common in which of the following places?
quiz.solution: Secret cults are a major menace specifically associated with universities, polytechnics, and colleges of education.

quiz.q: 1999 Constitution is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Supreme.

quiz.q: Judiciary function:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Interpret laws.

quiz.q: Flag White:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Peace.

quiz.q: Sovereignty:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Supreme power.

quiz.q: Which of these is a democratic value?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Tolerance.

quiz.q: Public service refers to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Government employment.

quiz.q: Civil society organizations (CSOs) are:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Non-governmental groups.

quiz.q: NDLEA fights against:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Drug abuse/Trafficking.

quiz.q: The Nigerian Coat of Arms: The Eagle represents:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Strength.

quiz.q: Federalism shares power between:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Center and Components.

quiz.q: One reason why students join cults is...
options: Peer pressure and false sense of security
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Peer pressure and false sense of security.

quiz.q: Orderliness in society involves...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Following established procedures and laws.

quiz.q: A major cause of road accidents in Nigeria is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Over-speeding.

quiz.q: Popular participation involves:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Citizens taking part in government.

quiz.q: Contentment helps to prevent:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Greed and Corruption.

quiz.q: Popular Participation:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Citizens involved.

quiz.q: Stigmatization of HIV patients means:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Discrimination and rejection.

quiz.q: The white in the Nigerian flag stands for:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Peace and Unity.

quiz.q: Responsible parenthood involves:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Caring for children.
